message.content: Logistic regression is a statistical method used for binary classification problems. It models the probability that a given input belongs to one of two classes (e.g., success/failure, yes/no) using a logistic function. The model estimates parameters (weights) that maximize the likelihood of observing the training data. Once trained, logistic regression can predict class probabilities and assign labels based on a chosen threshold.
